name: CalFresh Online
description: Through the EBT Online Purchasing Pilot, CalFresh (California's SNAP/food stamps program) households and SUN Bucks families can buy groceries online from approved retailers, making food access more convenient for those with transportation or mobility challenges.
fullDescription: Through the EBT Online Purchasing Pilot, CalFresh (California's SNAP/food stamps program) households and SUN Bucks families can buy groceries online from approved retailers, making food access more convenient for those with transportation or mobility challenges.
whatTheyOffer:
- Online grocery ordering with EBT food benefits
- Available only at USDA-approved online retailers (such as Amazon and Walmart)
- Same eligible food items as in-store
- Returns with a receipt are refunded to your EBT card
- Food benefits can't pay delivery fees, and cash benefits can't be used online
howToGetIt: If you have a CalFresh EBT card, check the USDA "Stores that accept SNAP online" list (linked from the CDSS page) and choose California. Create an account with an approved retailer, add your EBT card, and shop for eligible groceries.
keywords: CalFresh, EBT, food stamps, SNAP, online grocery, Amazon, Walmart, Safeway, grocery delivery, EBT online
